name: judge-logo-crown
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/ui-preview/logo.crown.normal.png --description "Royal Fiesta game logo: glossy gold inflatable crown with gem balls above the words ROYAL FIESTA in chunky rounded letters on a pink inflatable band, SDF Modeler preview on a sky background" --reference /refs/ref-1.png --min-score 6 --aspect design

name: judge-button-secondary-normal
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/ui-preview/button.secondary.normal.png --description "A game UI secondary button seen alone on a sky-blue background, in the inflatable glossy toy style of the reference (bright plastic, Fall Guys-like): a wide sky-blue pill shaped like an inflated cushion, with a white glossy streak across the top and a deeper blue rim. There is no text on it." --min-score 6

name: judge-button-secondary-focus
command: python3 "$NMC_JUDGE_CLIENT" out/ui-preview/button.secondary.focus.png --description "A game UI secondary button seen alone on a sky-blue background, in the inflatable glossy toy style of the reference (bright plastic, Fall Guys-like): a wide sky-blue pill shaped like an inflated cushion, with a white glossy streak across the top and a deeper blue rim. There is no text on it. It has a bright yellow glowing ring around it, showing keyboard focus." --min-score 6
